name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: The goblin racers are waiting on a promised part as the gnomes gain ground. Pozzik sends you to Ratchet to ask Gazlowe what happened.

sections.title: A Promised Part
sections.body:
Pozzik calls the racing team the pride of goblins. Many people help it in one way or another. Gazlowe searches the world for parts and once came to work on one of its rigs.

Weeks ago, Gazlowe promised a new prototype fuel regulator, but it has not arrived. He is usually prompt, so Pozzik asks you to go to Ratchet and learn what happened. The gnomes are gaining.

sections.title: Words About Pozzik
sections.body:
Before retiring to work with the racers, Pozzik was one of Undermine's most respected tinkerers, Gazlowe recalls. His first act on joining the team was to design its two engine model racers.

Gazlowe admits the Tinkers' Union may suffer without Pozzik. Still, he says nothing beats the races.

faq.q: Why does Pozzik need you to go to Ratchet?
faq.answer: Weeks ago, Gazlowe promised a prototype fuel regulator, but it has not arrived. Pozzik asks you to go to Ratchet and ask what happened.

faq.q: What does Gazlowe do for the racing team?
faq.answer: Gazlowe searches the world for parts for the team. He once came to work on one of its rigs.

aliases: what quest comes before goblin sponsorship
faq.answer: It follows Load Lightening, also given by Pozzik.

faq.q: Why is the goblin team in a hurry?
faq.answer: Pozzik says the gnomes are gaining on the goblin team.
